ingredients.title: Cream cheese layer
items: 2 packages (3 oz each) cream cheese, softened

instructions.title: Cream cheese layer
items: In a small bowl, beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth.
Spoon into crust. Sprinkle with chopped pecans.

instructions.title: Pudding layer
items: In a bowl, whisk the milk, vanilla and pudding mixes for 2 minutes.
Let stand for 2 minutes or until soft-set.
Spoon over the pecans. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours.

instructions.title: Topping
items: Top with whipped cream and pecan halves.
